name: Mori Misato
source:
"N-no... I... have a husband...!"


A faithful and homely wife with one child.

At first glance, she appears to be a caring mother who loves her children, but behind that facade lies a lustful female who revels in the suffocating body odor of young men.

Her love for young men has led her to look after the student soccer club, and Tetsuo, a member of the soccer club, finds himself caught up in an inescapable vortex of flesh.

[Translated from [url=https://www.a-kaguya.com/products_HB/chikandensya/chikan_top.htm]Official Site[/url]
